description: This Kotlin source file defines a RecyclerView Adapter named NotesAdapter for displaying a list of Note objects in an Android application. It includes inner class VH for ViewHolder management and methods for binding data and handling user interactions.

classes.name: NotesAdapter
classes.description: An adapter class for populating a RecyclerView with Note items, handling item view creation, data binding, and click interactions.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Updates the adapter with a new list of notes and refreshes the display.

inner_classes.name: VH
inner_classes.description: ViewHolder class that holds references to item views in the RecyclerView.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new ViewHolder for an item.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of items in the list.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data from a Note to the ViewHolder.
